proposals.title: Write hash and encoder ADRs and implement packages/core nominal types, positional RNG, and CanonicalEncoder
proposals.why_now: packages/core is the prerequisite for every other FASE-1 deliverable. The spec explicitly requires ADR-009 to be written before any StateHash exists, and the hash function must be specified bit-by-bit in an ADR before the positional rand() function can be implemented. No other FASE-1 unit can proceed without the branded numeric types, the rand() function, or the CanonicalEncoder.

proposals.why_now: The price generator is the first external consumer of packages/core and the foundation of all market simulation. FASE-1 requires at minimum two assets and two noise layers. repository_assessment.current_state: Monorepo scaffold accepted: 16 workspace packages exist with TypeScript strict configuration, pure-package lint rules, boundary checker, and CI gates. Every production source file is an empty placeholder (`export {}`). No ADRs have been written. No nominal types, RNG, CanonicalEncoder, price generator, ledger, Electron shell, or tools CLI exist.
repository_assessment.highest_priority_gap: packages/core is entirely unimplemented and is the prerequisite for every other FASE-1 deliverable. Three DEFINIR items must be resolved by ADR before core can be written: the hash function (ADR-002), the technical enforcement of division rounding modes (ADR-004), and the CanonicalEncoder spec (ADR-009). The spec requires ADR-009 to exist before any StateHash is computed.

warnings: The boundary checker defines tools: [] (no allowed import edges for tools/*). However, tools/replay and tools/bench must import from workspace packages — at minimum packages/core and packages/application — to perform replay and benchmarking. The §14.5 dependency graph does not include a tools node at all; the current implementation chose the strictest interpretation. Before implementing tools/replay or tools/bench, an ADR must resolve which direct edges tools/ may use, or the boundary gate will reject any functional tools implementation. This is a specification gap, not a contradiction: §14.5 omits tools from the graph, and §13 says tools are impure by nature but subject to the §14.5 dependency rule.

ADR-004 requires that calling division without an explicit rounding mode be a compile-time error or a blocking lint error, but the technical mechanism is marked DEFINIR. No ADR has been written for this. Without resolving it, the lint gate cannot enforce division hygiene, and the correctness guarantees backing INV-04 and INV-07 rest on programmer discipline rather than automated enforcement.
